Hollis isn't on the approved list for finance figures, so I need your OK before I put the rate in a draft to them. Can you approve? Once she says yes, I'll save the draft to Hollis (hmbeki@pemberline.com) in your mailbox with the subject "Quarrendon 2027 rate" and the $2,356 per-seat figure, and you can send it from there.
